thread:
jamie: FYI AcmeCorp reported invoice INV-4521 missing billing reference (PO). They attempted payment but our gateway flagged it as "unmatched_reference". Customer needs invoice reissued with PO on header so AP can auto-match. Escalating to billing/finance.

sara_cs: Thanks — can you paste the account id and the PO they want on file?

jamie: Account: ACME-778. PO#: PO-998877. Invoice: https://app.redwood.com/invoices/INV-4521 (internal). Payment attempt log shows gateway decline due to unmatched/missing reference.

liam_fin: I pulled the invoice. custom_fields.po_number is blank on INV-4521. Proposed path:
1) Issue credit memo for INV-4521
2) Create new invoice INV-4521-R1 with PO-998877 in billing reference
3) Apply credit to original and mark refunded; reconcile payment to new invoice once customer re-submits or we reprocess
I'll create the credit memo now.

nina_billing: Note — customer is EU (DE). Original invoice had VAT 19%. For reissue we need to preserve VAT treatment or issue a corrective "Gutschrift". Please add a small explanatory note on the reissued PDF: "Correction: invoice reissued to include customer's PO; tax treatment unchanged." That avoids AP confusion.

invoices-bot: payment_event - gateway_decline - INV-4521 - reason: unmatched_reference - 2026-02-11T10:22:01Z

liam_fin: Credit memo created: CM-3302. Drafting new invoice INV-4521-R1 now and will include PO and the tax note. Ping @ops_oncall to run the private billing reissue flow (needed for DE VAT handling).

ops_oncall: Got it. Running reissue via internal flow. Command I will run:
```
/billing reissue --from INV-4521 --to INV-4521-R1 --po PO-998877 --preserve-tax --note "Reissued to include PO; preserve VAT"
```
ETA ~45m. Will also attach PDF with PO on header per customer request.

jamie: Please cc ap@acme.example when sending the new invoice and include a short note with steps for applying the previous payment/credit. Customer specifically asked for PDF with the PO in the header.

liam_fin: Reissue finished. INV-4521-R1 sent to ap@acme.example, credit CM-3302 applied to original invoice. Internal reconciliation ref: TKT-6578. AP should be able to re-apply the earlier payment to the new invoice; leaving instructions in invoice email.

sara_cs: I'll follow up with Acme AP contact to confirm they received the new PDF and that they can close the payment. Will set a 72h follow-up to confirm reconciliation.

jamie: Great — marking resolved for now and moving to billing queue (SLA: 72h follow-up). :white_check_mark:
